name: polarion-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Polarion ALM REST API, with an optional HTTP wrapper for Custom GPTs.
author: Phillip Bösger

scripts.build: rm -rf build && tsc && chmod 755 build/index.js build/http-server.js
scripts.build:http: rm -rf build && tsc && chmod 755 build/http-server.js && cp build/http-server.js build/index.js
scripts.test: rm -rf build-tests && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test build-tests/tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs && node evals/run.mjs --validate-only
scripts.test:e2e: rm -rf build-tests && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test build-tests/tests/e2e/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf build-tests coverage && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && c8 --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --exclude-after-remap --exclude=src/tools.ts --exclude=tests/** node --test build-tests/tests/*.test.js tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:mutation: npm run test:compile && mkdir -p reports/mutation && for module in oauth sealed guards tool-filter executor; do MUTATION_MODULE="$module" stryker run tests/stryker.config.mjs > "reports/mutation/$module.txt" 2>&1 || exit $?; done
scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('tsconfig.json') && fs.existsSync('src') && fs.existsSync('node_modules/.bin/tsc')) require('child_process').execSync('npm run build', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.generate-tools: node scripts/generate-tools.mjs .gen/src/index.ts src/tools.ts && node scripts/enrich-tool-metadata.mjs && node scripts/enrich-response-format.mjs && node scripts/enrich-output-schemas.mjs && node scripts/enrich-max-items.mjs
scripts.regenerate: npm run download-spec && npm run fix-sparse-fields && npm run generate-mcp && npm run generate-tools && npm run build && npm test
